scene_description: A person with long hair stands facing large windows, holding a rolling suitcase with a bag on top. An airplane is visible flying in the sky outside the windows.

questions.question: What is the person pulling?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at what the person is holding with their hand near the ground.

questions.question: What is flying in the sky?
questions.evidence_hint: Look up in the top right corner of the picture.

questions.question: Who is standing by the window?
questions.evidence_hint: Look in the middle of the picture near the big windows.

questions.question: Where is the airplane?
questions.evidence_hint: Look through the big windows at the top of the picture.

questions.question: What is on top of the suitcase?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the suitcase and what is sitting on top of it.
